summary.text: Darren Thorne is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who was appointed to District 15 in December 2024 and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
A farmer, he previously served in the House of Delegates from 2022 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Darren Thorne's career experience includes working as a farmer.
He represented House of Delegates District 89 from 2022 to 2025.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Thorne to the State Senate on December 20, 2024, to replace Charles S. Trump IV, and he took office on January 3, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Senate Agriculture Committee and also serves on the Economic Development, Finance, Government Organization, Pensions and Workforce committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
